summary: Prime table (Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 3572) and get_prime/checked_multiply utilities for accumulator combination identity encoding.

key_functions.name: get_prime
key_functions.summary: Returns the prime at 0-based index from PRIME_TABLE; raises IndexError if out of range.

key_functions.name: checked_multiply
key_functions.summary: Multiplies two ints, raising OverflowError if the result exceeds int64 max.

lifecycle_notes: PRIME_TABLE contains primes up to 3572 (~500 primes); partitions exceeding 500 rules will raise IndexError from get_prime.
Prime products are stored as int64 in the DataFrame; checked_multiply guards against overflow.
documentation_hooks: Document the 500-rule-per-partition limit in the AccumulatorEngine user guide.
risks: Partitions with more than ~500 rules will raise IndexError. The limit is not documented at the AccumulatorEngine API level.
